proof_rules: Merged PR proves source integration only, NOT a deployed service.
Original GitHub bot comment about public metadata proves bounded job execution only, not platform fact verification.
An open issue or a green CI test cannot certify private browser, Cloudflare, WhatsApp, or always-on host acceptance.
No task is silently marked complete by its own author's draft. Fresh reviewer flags missing independent evidence.
Future user requests require explicit addition of a public nonconfidential objective or an authorized private instruction intake; no private chats auto-exported to public GitHub.
